mechanism: Selegiline inhibits MAO-B and can increase dopamine/norepinephrine levels, while perphenazine is a dopamine antagonist; combined use risks reduced antipsychotic efficacy and potential hypertensive crisis via sympathomimetic potentiation.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses with careful monitoring of blood pressure, mental status, and extrapyramidal symptoms; consider alternative antipsychotic with less dopamine antagonism.
